title: iOS/iPadOS Enterprise SSO App Extension for Corporate-Owned iPhones (Microsoft Enterprise SSO Plug-in via Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (iOS/iPadOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity work, live-fleet care). Priced at $2495 at parity with the macOS Enterprise SSO App Extension (MACSSOEXT) T3 sibling.

Gap-only: MACSSOEXT owns the macOS side; IOSDD only uses the iOS SSO extension inside the two-phone scenario. This product is the standalone iOS Enterprise SSO app extension for corporate-owned iPhones/iPads.

iOS specifics baked in: extension hosted in Microsoft Authenticator (not Company Portal); extension id com.microsoft.azureauthenticator.ssoextension; Device-features 'Microsoft Entra ID' SSO extension type; Enable_SSO_On_All_ManagedApps coverage key.
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; identifiers flagged 'verify in your tenant', not invented.
Commercial-only per owner directive (no GCC High variant this run); Gov tier is price-only.
